title: The Butter Tub Protocol
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: night, violent storm, slate-blue and grey palette, driving rain, lightning flashes.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important; Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks; a gunmetal-grey armoured aerial sentinel drone with a crimson optical visor, exposed sparking circuitry and venting steam.
Camera: push-in from medium to close-up on the butter tub; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: The drone's sparking core pops loose and skitters across the grating; Tomkin slams the yellow butter tub down over it, trapping it. The tub rattles and fizzes, then goes still. Penny and the hero exchange an amazed look.
Dialogue: Penny (calm, practical, quick-witted teenage girl's voice, dryly amused, amazed and amused) says: "You saved us with a butter tub."
Sound: skittering metal, plastic thunk, muffled fizzing, rain easing.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
